name: LM-Polygraph
description: A novel benchmark for evaluating uncertainty quantification (UQ) methods in large language models across various text generation tasks. It implements state-of-the-art UQ baselines and provides an environment for consistent and controllable evaluation of UQ techniques and confidence normalization methods.
reputation: A relatively new benchmark that is cited within the LLM uncertainty-quantification community, but it has not yet reached broad mainstream adoption.
notes: Supports assessment of confidence normalization methods and includes eleven tasks for large-scale empirical investigation.
